title: Buyer's guide.
bodyText: The commissioner by rule shall require delivery of a buyer's guide or a similar consumer advisory package to owners during the process of soliciting a life settlement contract.
bodyHtml: [§431C-34]  Buyer's guide.  The commissioner by rule shall require delivery of a buyer's guide or a similar consumer advisory package to owners during the process of soliciting a life settlement contract. [L 2012, c 256, pt of §1]
